evidence_type: Controlled reversible app-driven LDAC quality test, observed read-only through ADB dumpsys on the owner's authorized phone
tested_at_local: 2026-11-24 evening (phone clock); exact UTC in private captures
device: Nothing A001 (Galaga / GalagaIND), Android 16, build BP2A.250605.031.A3
headset: realme TechLife Studio H1, LDAC active and the active A2DP device throughout

app.note: The owner updated the app mid-session because the earlier UI did not apply the change; after the update the UI did apply it. The updated installation is split into base plus arm64/xxhdpi splits, so its hash is not directly comparable with the single-file APKPure 2.6.1 artifact retained privately.

conclusion: On the owner's unrooted Android 16 phone, the unmodified 2.6.1 app changed the active LDAC policy from 1000 to 1001 and back using its normal user-facing controls. No root, ADB grant, privileged permission, re-signing or re-pairing was needed. This converts the earlier static no-root route from a code-level finding into an observed runtime result for this app/device combination.
limitations: The stack's reported bitrate is the configured policy, not a measured radio bitrate or an audio-quality blind test.

The audio HAL reported AUDIO_FORMAT_AAC during captures, consistent with no active LDAC media stream at those instants; the A2DP codec policy and codec status still reported LDAC. Active-playback behaviour was not separately measured.
Only one down-and-up transition was tested; reconnect persistence, HFP/call switching and repeated toggles were not tested.
The earlier 2.4.1 UI did not visibly apply the change in this session; the cause (bug, paywall or build difference) was not established. Do not generalize to older versions.

shell_runner_attempt.observation: A temporary reflection-only runner launched as ADB shell could read codec status and reach IBluetoothA2dp, but its constructed config was rejected by A2dpCodecConfig as 'invalid codec' because the 9-arg BluetoothCodecConfig constructor order is codecType, codecPriority, sampleRate, bitsPerSample, channelMode, codecSpecific1..4, not the order initially assumed. No policy change occurred. All pushed runner files were removed from /data/local/tmp.
shell_runner_attempt.relevance: Shows the shell-privileged route was not needed for the successful result and was not relied upon for any conclusion here.

privacy: MAC address, USB serial, full dumpsys captures and proprietary APKs are retained only in the approved private temporary directory and are not reproduced here.
